        has_open_space_behind and is_attacking_third and has_support and is_carrier_faster
    )

    pattern_desperate_sideline_escape = (
        is_sideline_trapped and is_fast_closing and has_open_space_behind and (has_support or is_carrier_faster)
    )

    pattern_free_space_takeon = (
        not is_tight_space and has_open_space_behind and is_retreating_defender and has_support
    )

    score = (
        int(pattern_speed_advantage)
        + int(pattern_pressure_with_support)
        + int(pattern_attacking_third_opportunity)
        + int(pattern_desperate_sideline_escape)
        + int(pattern_free_space_takeon)
    )

    should_take_on = score >= 1

    return 1 if should_take_on else 0

def predict_take_on(f: dict, p: dict) -> int:
    is_tight_space = f["distance_m"] < p["tight_space_distance_m"]
    is_head_on_approach = f["approach_angle_deg"] < p["head_on_approach_angle_deg"]
    is_defender_retreating = f["approach_angle_deg"] > (180.0 - p["head_on_approach_angle_deg"])
    is_fast_closing = f["closing_speed_mps"] > p["fast_closing_speed_mps"]
    is_carrier_faster = f["carrier_speed_mps"] > f["opponent_speed_mps"]
    has_space_beyond = f["second_nearest_dist_m"] > p["open_space_second_dist_m"]
    has_support = f["n_supporting_teammates"] >= p["support_min_count"]
    is_pressed_to_sideline = f["dist_to_sideline_m"] < p["sideline_trap_distance_m"]
    is_attacking_third = f["dist_to_goal_line_m"] < p["attacking_third_distance_m"]

    pattern_speed_advantage = (
        is_tight_space and is_head_on_approach and is_carrier_faster and has_space_beyond
    )

    pattern_defender_off_balance = (
        is_defender_retreating and not is_pressed_to_sideline and has_space_beyond
    )

    pattern_supported_risk_take = (
        is_tight_space and is_fast_closing and has_support and not is_pressed_to_sideline
    )

    pattern_final_third_isolation = (
        is_attacking_third and has_space_beyond and is_tight_space and not is_pressed_to_sideline
    )

    should_take_on = (
        pattern_speed_advantage
        or pattern_defender_off_balance
        or pattern_supported_risk_take
        or pattern_final_third_isolation
    )

    return 1 if should_take_on else 0
